23749-the-mythological-zoo.title: The Mythological Zoo
23749-the-mythological-zoo.creator: Oliver Herford
23749-the-mythological-zoo.description: A book by Oliver Herford. The Dolphin was, if you should wish To call him so,--the King of Fish. Though having neither gills nor scales, His title _should be_ Prince of Whales. While too small waisted to provide A Jonah with a Berth Inside, The Dolphin has been known to pack A Drowning Sailor on his back And bear him safely into port,-- He was a Taxi-whale, in short.

arxiv-1510-07409.title: Interaction of antiprotons with nuclei Journal: Nuclear Physics A
arxiv-1510-07409.creator: Jaroslava Hrtánková and Jiří Mareš
arxiv-1510-07409.description: Abstract We performed fully self-consistent calculations of p ¯ \bar{p} -nuclear bound states using a complex p ¯ {\bar{p}} -nucleus potential accounting for p ¯ \bar{p} -atom data. While the real part of the potential is constructed within the relativistic mean-field (RMF) model, the p ¯ \bar{p} annihilation in the nuclear medium is described by a phenomenological optical potential.

arxiv-2107-12837.title: Challenges for FCC-ee Luminosity Monitor Design
arxiv-2107-12837.creator: Mogens Dam
arxiv-2107-12837.description: Abstract For cross section measurements, an accurate knowledge of the integrated luminosity is required. The FCC-ee Z lineshape programme sets the ambitious precision goal of 10 − 4 10^{-4} on the absolute luminosity measurement and one order of magnitude better on the relative measurement between energy-scan points.

arxiv-2111-02107.title: General considerations in unbalanced fourth-order interference
arxiv-2111-02107.creator: Z. Y. Ou, Xiaoying Li
arxiv-2111-02107.description: Abstract Interferometry has been used widely in sensing application. However, the technique is limited by the finite coherence time of the light sources when the interference paths are not balanced. Higher-order interference effects involve intensity correlations between multiple detectors and may have the advantage over the traditional second order interference effect exhibited in only one detector.

arxiv-2311-03696.title: Bilingual Corpus Mining and Multistage Fine-Tuning for Improving Machine Translation of Lecture Transcripts
arxiv-2311-03696.creator: Haiyue Song, Raj Dabre, Chenhui Chu, Atsushi Fujita, Sadao Kurohashi
arxiv-2311-03696.description: Abstract Lecture transcript translation helps learners understand online courses, however, building a high-quality lecture machine translation system lacks publicly available parallel corpora. To address this, we examine a framework for parallel corpus mining, which provides a quick and effective way to mine a parallel corpus from publicly available lectures on Coursera.

arxiv-2403-18478.title: A consistent kinetic Fokker-Planck model for gas mixtures
arxiv-2403-18478.creator: Marlies Pirner
arxiv-2403-18478.description: Abstract We propose a general multi-species Fokker-Planck model. We prove consistency of our model: conservation properties, positivity of all temperatures, H-Theorem and the shape of equilibrium as Maxwell distributions with the same mean velocity and temperature. Moreover, we derive the usual macroscopic equations from the kinetic two-species BGK model and compute explicitly the exchange terms of momentum and energy.

arxiv-2405-06343.title: DarsakX: A Python Package for Designing and Analyzing Imaging Performance of X-ray Telescopes
arxiv-2405-06343.creator: Neeraj K. Tiwari, Santosh V. Vadawale, N. P. S. Mithun, C. S. Vaishnava, Bharath Saiguhan
arxiv-2405-06343.description: Abstract The imaging performance and sensitivity of an X-ray telescope when observing astrophysical sources are primarily governed by the optical design, geometrical uncertainties (figure errors, surface roughness, and mirror alignment inaccuracies), and the reflectivity properties of the X-ray reflecting mirror surface.

arxiv-2406-14659.title: Algebraic proof of modular form inequalities for optimal sphere packings
arxiv-2406-14659.creator: Seewoo Lee
arxiv-2406-14659.description: Abstract . We give algebraic proofs of Viazovska and Cohn-Kumar-Miller-Radchenko-Viazovska’s modular form inequalities for 8 and 24-dimensional optimal sphere packings. 1. Introduction In their celebrated papers [ 16 , 3 ] , Viazovska and Cohn–Kumar–Miller–Radchenko–Viazovska proved the optimality of E_{8} and Leech lattice sphere packings in dimensions 8 and 24 , respectively.

arxiv-2410-10988.creator: R. Begley, R. J. McLure, F. Cullen, D. J. McLeod, J. S. Dunlop, A. C. Carnall, T. M. Stanton, A. E. Shapley, R. Cochrane, C. T. Donnan, R.S. Ellis, A. Fontana, N. A. Grogin, A. M. Koekemoer
arxiv-2410-10988.description: Abstract Accurately quantifying the ionizing photon production efficiency ( ξ ion \xi_{\mathrm{ion}} ) of z ≳ 6 z\gtrsim 6 star-forming galaxies (SFGs) is necessary to fully understand their contribution to reionization. In this study, we investigate the ionizing properties of N = 279 N=279 SFGs selected at z ≃ 6.9 − 7.6 z\simeq 6.9-7.

arxiv-2501-05646.title: Efficient Representations for High-Cardinality Categorical Variables in Machine Learning
arxiv-2501-05646.creator: Zixuan Liang
arxiv-2501-05646.description: Abstract High-cardinality categorical variables pose significant challenges in machine learning, particularly in terms of computational efficiency and model interpretability. Traditional one-hot encoding often results in high-dimensional sparse feature spaces, increasing the risk of overfitting and reducing scalability. This paper introduces novel encoding techniques, including means encoding, low-rank encoding, and multinomial logistic regression encoding, to address these challenges.

pmc-10793622.creator: Przemysław Stefaniak, Bartłomiej Emil Kraziński, Jacek Kieżun, Hanna Majewska, Janusz Godlewski

pmc-11657530.title: Multimodal HSI Combined with Multiblock Data Fusion: A New Tool for the Study of Time-Dependent Alteration Processes in Dyed Textiles
pmc-11657530.creator: Zelan Li, Alessia Candeo, Emilio Catelli, Marta Ghirardello, Paolo Oliveri, Cristian Manzoni, Silvia Prati, Daniela Comelli, Giorgia Sciutto
pmc-11657530.description: The present study describes an innovative approach for the study of time-dependent alteration processes. It combines an advanced hyperspectral imaging (HSI) system, to collect visible reflectance and fluorescence spectral data sets sequentially, with a tailored multiblock data processing method. This enables the modeling of chemical degradation maps and the early, spatially resolved detection of dye alteration in textiles.

pmc-12611153.title: Epidemiology and clinical profile of diarrhea associated with enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli and Vibrio cholerae in Bangladesh: Findings from a hospital-based surveillance system, 2008–2023
pmc-12611153.creator: Jinat Alam, Shamsun Nahar Shaima, Rina Das, Md. Ahshanul Haque, Md. Nasif Hossain, Soroar Hossain Khan, Sharika Nuzhat, Mohammod Jobayer Chisti, Tahmeed Ahmed, Subhra Chakraborty, A. S. G. Faruque, Vangelis Economou, Elsio Wunder Jr, Elsio Wunder Jr
pmc-12611153.description: BackgroundEnterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC) and Vibrio cholerae are notable enteric bacterial pathogens that cause diarrheal illnesses in resource-limited settings (e.g., Bangladesh). We aimed to explore the epidemiology and the clinical presentation of diarrhea caused by either V. cholerae or ETEC as a single-pathogen, or as a co-infection with both pathogens among patients requiring hospitalization.

pmc-12616035.title: Visual field asymmetries develop throughout adolescence
pmc-12616035.creator: Marisa Carrasco, Caroline Myers, Mariel Roberts
pmc-12616035.description: SummaryFor human adults, visual perception varies with polar angle at isoeccentric locations from the center of gaze. The same visual information yields better performance along the horizontal than vertical meridian (horizontal vertical anisotropy, HVA) and along the lower than upper vertical meridian (vertical meridian asymmetry, VMA).

pmc-13627027.title: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia associated with genetic susceptibility and occupational glyphosate exposure: a case report
pmc-13627027.creator: Rachel M. Fiegener, Lindsay C. Scally, Raha Abbasian, Abigail L. Warren, James M. Small
pmc-13627027.description: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) is the most common adult leukemia in Western countries, typically diagnosed in older adults, with a median age of 72. Despite its prevalence, the etiology is unclear, and cases at younger ages have been increasingly reported.
